klondike_classic.name: Klondike (Classic)
klondike_classic.shortDesc: The iconic Windows solitaire — draw 1, infinite recycles.

0.title: Goal
0.body: Place all 52 cards on the 4 foundations, sorted by suit, from Ace to King.

1.title: Setup
1.body: 7 columns on the tableau (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 cards). Only the last card of each column is face-up. The remaining 24 cards form the stock.

2.title: Tableau
2.body: Descending runs (King → Ace) with alternating colors: red on black, black on red. Example: 9♥ on 10♠.

3.title: Stock
3.body: Tap the stock → 1 card to the waste. Infinite recycles: when the stock is empty, the waste flips back to form the stock.

4.title: Win
4.body: All 4 foundations complete (52 cards placed, Ace → King).

klondike_turn1.name: Klondike Turn 1
klondike_turn1.shortDesc: Klondike with 1-card draw — the most beginner-friendly version.

0.title: Goal
0.body: Same as classic Klondike: fill the 4 foundations Ace → King by suit.

1.title: Difference
1.body: Tapping the stock reveals ONE card at a time — so every stock card is playable. This is the most winnable version.

2.title: Recycles
2.body: Unlimited. You can flip the waste back to stock as many times as needed.

3.title: Tip
3.body: Prefer uncovering a hidden card over playing from the waste.

klondike_turn3.name: Klondike Turn 3
klondike_turn3.shortDesc: Draw 3 cards at once — only the top one is immediately playable.

0.title: Goal
0.body: Same as classic Klondike: 4 foundations Ace → King.

1.title: Difference
1.body: Tapping the stock reveals 3 cards at once. Only the top one is immediately playable. To reach the others, play the top or wait for a recycle.

2.title: Strategy
2.body: Anticipate which triplets will come out. Remember positions at 1/3 and 2/3 — they may unlock later.

3.title: Recycles
3.body: Unlimited (standard); some stricter rules limit to 3 passes.

vegas_solitaire.name: Vegas Solitaire
vegas_solitaire.shortDesc: Klondike Turn 3 with a $52 bet and only one pass through the stock.

0.title: Initial bet
0.body: You wager $52 at start ($1 per card).

1.title: Score
1.body: +$5 per card placed on the foundations. Goal: finish with more than $52 for a net win.

2.title: Stock
2.body: 3 cards per draw, like Turn 3. Only ONE pass — no recycles.

3.title: Min target
3.body: Place at least 11 cards on the foundations to break even.

4.title: Tip
4.body: Be aggressive on foundations — no second chance.

double_klondike.name: Double Klondike
double_klondike.shortDesc: Klondike played with 2 decks — 8 foundations to complete.

0.title: Setup
0.body: 9 columns (1 to 9 cards). 8 empty foundations (2 per suit).

1.title: Tableau
1.body: Descending alternating colors, like classic Klondike.

2.title: Foundations
2.body: For each suit (♠ ♥ ♦ ♣), 2 foundations to fill independently, Ace → King.

3.title: Stock
3.body: 1 card at a time, unlimited recycles.

4.title: Win
4.body: 8 foundations complete = 104 cards.

5.title: Note
5.body: This session plays with the standard 1-deck Klondike engine. 2-deck mode coming soon.

westcliff.name: Westcliff
westcliff.shortDesc: Klondike with 10 columns of 3 — all face-up from the start.

0.title: Setup
0.body: 10 columns of 3 cards each (30 on tableau). 22 cards in the stock.

1.title: Particularity
1.body: All tableau cards are visible from the start — this is an 'open-air' Klondike.

2.title: Tableau
2.body: Descending alternating colors, like standard Klondike.

3.title: Stock
3.body: 1 card per tap. The waste recycles only ONCE.

4.title: Note
4.body: This session uses the standard Klondike engine. 10-column layout coming soon.

thumb_and_pouch.name: Thumb and Pouch
thumb_and_pouch.shortDesc: Klondike with relaxed stacking — stack on any color except the same suit.

0.title: Key difference
0.body: On the tableau, you can stack on ANY color, EXCEPT the same suit. More permissive than classic Klondike.

1.title: Empty column
1.body: Any card (not just a King) can occupy an empty column.

2.title: Stock
2.body: 1 card at a time, unlimited recycles.

3.title: Note
3.body: This session plays with strict Klondike rules. Thumb-and-Pouch relaxation coming soon.

spider_1suit.name: Spider 1 Suit
spider_1suit.shortDesc: Easy variant — 104 cards, but a single suit (all Spades).

0.title: Goal
0.body: Build 8 complete runs King → Ace (all in spades). Each completed run is auto-moved to foundations.

1.title: Setup
1.body: 10 columns (4 of 6 cards, 6 of 5 cards — 54 total, all but last face-down). 50 cards remaining in stock (5 deals of 10).

2.title: Tableau
2.body: Descending runs (King → Ace). In 1 suit, all cards are 'compatible' — you can always move a complete run.

3.title: Stock
3.body: Tap the stock → deals 1 card to each of the 10 columns. FORBIDDEN if any column is empty.

4.title: Win
4.body: 8 complete King → Ace runs removed from the tableau.

0.title: Difference vs 1 suit
0.body: Uses ♠ AND ♥. You can stack on any color in a descending run, BUT you can only MOVE a run if it's entirely the same suit.

1.title: Strategy
1.body: Build pure sub-runs (all ♠ or all ♥) before moving them in bulk.

2.title: Stock
2.body: Deals 1 card per column. Forbidden if any column is empty.

0.title: Setup
0.body: 2 complete decks (♠ ♥ ♦ ♣ × 2).

1.title: Challenge
1.body: You must isolate each suit in sub-runs before moving them. Reserved for patient experts.

2.title: Tip
2.body: Keep at least one empty column for reorganization. Dealing from stock is very costly.

spiderette.name: Spiderette
spiderette.shortDesc: Mini-Spider with 1 deck (52 cards) — 7 columns, 4 runs to build.

0.title: Setup
0.body: 7 columns (Klondike layout 1-2-3-4-5-6-7), 4 foundations (instead of 8). 24 cards in stock.

1.title: Tableau
1.body: Same as Spider 1 Suit: descending runs, same color (free movement).

2.title: Win
2.body: 4 complete King → Ace runs (instead of 8).

3.title: Note
3.body: This session uses the standard 2-deck Spider engine.

freecell_classic.name: FreeCell (Classic)
freecell_classic.shortDesc: 99.999% of deals solvable — pure logic, no hidden chance.

0.title: Goal
0.body: Place all 52 cards on the 4 foundations (Ace → King by suit).

1.title: Setup
1.body: 8 columns (4 of 7 cards, 4 of 6). All cards visible. 4 free cells + 4 empty foundations.

2.title: Free cells
2.body: Each cell holds 1 card — temporary parking.

3.title: Tableau
3.body: Descending + alternating colors. Empty column accepts any card.

4.title: Multi-moves
4.body: Officially 1 card at a time. In practice, multi-moves are allowed if you have enough free cells + empty columns.

bakers_game.name: Baker's Game
bakers_game.shortDesc: FreeCell with same-suit stacking — much harder.

0.title: Difference
0.body: Tableau stacking is by SAME suit descending (♠ on ♠, ♥ on ♥) instead of alternating colors.

1.title: Otherwise identical
1.body: 8 columns, 4 free cells, 4 foundations. All visible.

2.title: Strategy
2.body: Much more constraining. Save free cells for late-game crunch moments.

3.title: Note
3.body: This session uses standard FreeCell (alternating colors). Same-suit mode coming soon.

eight_off.name: Eight Off
eight_off.shortDesc: FreeCell with 8 cells instead of 4 — much more forgiving.

0.title: Setup
0.body: 8 columns of 6 cards (48 cards), 4 cards pre-placed in 4 of the 8 free cells.

1.title: Free cells
1.body: 8 total cells (4 free + 4 pre-occupied). Much more wiggle room.

2.title: Stacking
2.body: Same suit descending (like Baker's Game).

3.title: Note
3.body: This session uses standard FreeCell (4 cells, alternating colors).

seahaven_towers.name: Seahaven Towers
seahaven_towers.shortDesc: 10 columns of 5 cards + 2 pre-occupied cells — subtle balance.

0.title: Setup
0.body: 10 columns of 5 cards (50 total). 4 free cells with 2 pre-occupied at start.

1.title: Stacking
1.body: Same suit descending.

2.title: Empty column
2.body: Only a King can occupy an empty column.

3.title: Note
3.body: This session uses standard FreeCell. 10-column layout coming soon.

yukon_classic.name: Yukon (Classic)
yukon_classic.shortDesc: Klondike with no stock — all cards on tableau, free bulk-moves.

0.title: Setup
0.body: 7 columns: 1 / 6 / 7 / 8 / 9 / 10 / 11. No stock — all 52 cards on the tableau.

1.title: Tableau
1.body: Descending with alternating colors (like Klondike).

2.title: Unique flexibility
2.body: You can move ANY face-up card AND everything below it, even if not a valid run.

3.title: Empty column
3.body: Only a King (with its pile) can occupy an empty column.

4.title: Foundations
4.body: Ace → King by suit. Win = 4 foundations complete.

russian_solitaire.name: Russian Solitaire
russian_solitaire.shortDesc: Yukon with same-suit stacking — much harder.

0.title: Difference vs Yukon
0.body: Tableau stacking is by SAME suit descending (♠ on ♠), not alternating colors.

1.title: Yukon flexibility kept
1.body: You can still move any card with everything below it.

2.title: Note
2.body: This session uses the standard Yukon engine (alternating colors).

alaska.name: Alaska
alaska.shortDesc: Yukon where stacking accepts up OR down on the SAME suit.

0.title: Difference
0.body: Same-suit stacking, but ascending OR descending — you can put 9♠ on either 8♠ or 10♠.

1.title: Yukon flexibility
1.body: Move any card with what's below it (no strict run required).

2.title: Note
2.body: This session uses standard Yukon. Alaska rule coming soon.

golf_classic.name: Golf (Classic)
golf_classic.shortDesc: Score = cards remaining (goal: 0, like in real golf).

0.title: Goal
0.body: Empty the tableau. Like golf, your score is the number of cards left — LESS is better.

1.title: Setup
1.body: 7 columns of 5 face-up cards (35 on tableau). 17 cards in stock, 1 in the waste.

2.title: Rule
2.body: Move a top-of-column card to the waste if its value is ±1 vs the waste card. Suit doesn't matter.

3.title: Terminal King
3.body: King (13) is terminal — nothing chains after. You must draw.

4.title: Stock
4.body: Tap = 1 card to waste. No recycle.

putt_putt.name: Putt Putt
putt_putt.shortDesc: Circular Golf — Ace chains on King and vice versa.

0.title: Difference
0.body: Like classic Golf, BUT the sequence is circular: an Ace can follow a King and a King can follow an Ace. The King is no longer terminal.

1.title: Setup
1.body: 7 columns of 5, 17 cards in stock, 1 in waste.

2.title: Note
2.body: This session uses standard Golf (terminal King). Circular mode coming soon.

pyramid_classic.name: Pyramid (Classic)
pyramid_classic.shortDesc: Remove pairs that sum to 13 to empty the pyramid.

0.title: Goal
0.body: Empty the whole pyramid (28 cards) by removing pairs summing to 13.

1.title: Setup
1.body: 7 rows in a pyramid (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 cards). A card is usable only if no card overlaps it below.

2.title: Values
2.body: Ace = 1, 2-10 = face value, Jack = 11, Queen = 12, King = 13.

3.title: Valid pairs
3.body: A+Q, 2+J, 3+10, 4+9, 5+8, 6+7. King removes alone.

4.title: Stock
4.body: Tap → 1 card to waste. Pair pyramid card with waste card.

pyramid_relaxed.name: Pyramid (Relaxed)
pyramid_relaxed.shortDesc: Pyramid with unlimited stock recycles — much more playable.

0.title: Difference
0.body: Like classic Pyramid, BUT the stock can be recycled as many times as you want.

1.title: Strategy
1.body: You can let a pair slip by — it'll come back. Focus on the removal order in the pyramid.

2.title: Note
2.body: This session uses classic Pyramid (no recycle). Relaxed mode coming soon.

tripeaks_classic.name: TriPeaks (Classic)
tripeaks_classic.shortDesc: 3 peaks — chain cards ±1 to clear the tableau.

0.title: Goal
0.body: Clear the 3 peaks — 28 cards on the tableau.

1.title: Setup
1.body: 3 peaks sharing a base row. Only the bottom row is face-up at start.

2.title: Rule
2.body: Remove a face-up card if its value is ±1 vs the waste card. Suit irrelevant.

3.title: Circular
3.body: Ace ↔ King: an Ace can follow a King and vice versa.

4.title: Combos
4.body: Each chained card without drawing doubles the score: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32... Drawing resets the combo.

5.title: Stock
5.body: No recycle — 23 cards max in the stock.

forty_thieves_classic.name: Forty Thieves (Classic)
forty_thieves_classic.shortDesc: Very hard — 2 decks, 1 card at a time, no recycle.

0.title: Setup
0.body: 2 full decks (104 cards). 10 columns of 4 (all visible). 64 cards in stock. 8 empty foundations.

1.title: Tableau
1.body: Descending SAME-SUIT (♠ on ♠, ♥ on ♥). NO alternating colors.

2.title: 1 card at a time
2.body: You can only move ONE card (top of column or waste). No bulk moves.

3.title: Empty column
3.body: Any card can occupy an empty column.

4.title: Stock
4.body: 1 card per tap, NO recycle.

5.title: Foundations
5.body: 8 foundations (2 per suit). Ace → King by suit. Win = all complete (104 cards).

accordion_classic.name: Accordion (Classic)
accordion_classic.shortDesc: Compress 52 cards into ONE single pile — extreme patience puzzle.

0.title: Setup
0.body: 52 cards in a line, all face-up.

1.title: Rule
1.body: Move a card onto its immediate left neighbor OR 3 spots to the left, if they share VALUE OR SUIT.

2.title: Stacking
2.body: The moved card goes on top of the target pile. Cards to the right slide left to fill the gap.

3.title: Strategy
3.body: Don't rush — a wrong stack blocks the game permanently. Plan several moves ahead.

4.title: Win
4.body: Reduce 52 cards to ONE single pile. Very rare (~0.3% of deals) — the ultimate patience challenge.

triple_klondike.name: Triple Klondike
triple_klondike.shortDesc: Klondike played with 3 decks — 12 foundations to complete.

0.title: Setup
0.body: 13 columns (1 to 13 cards). 12 empty foundations (3 per suit).

1.title: Tableau
1.body: Descending alternating colors, like Klondike.

2.title: Foundations
2.body: For each suit: 3 foundations to fill independently, Ace → King.

3.title: Stock
3.body: 1 card at a time, unlimited recycles.

4.title: Win
4.body: 12 foundations complete = 156 cards.

5.title: Note
5.body: This session plays with the standard 1-deck Klondike engine.

easthaven.name: Easthaven
easthaven.shortDesc: Klondike-Spider hybrid — row-by-row deal from the stock.

0.title: Setup
0.body: 7 columns of 3 cards (21 cards). 31 cards in stock.

1.title: Tableau
1.body: Descending alternating colors (like Klondike).

2.title: Spider-style stock
2.body: Stock tap deals 1 card to EACH column at once (instead of a waste pile).

3.title: Foundations
3.body: Ace → King by suit, 4 foundations.

4.title: Note
4.body: This session uses the standard Klondike waste-pile stock.

agnes_sorel.name: Agnes Sorel
agnes_sorel.shortDesc: Klondike where the first stock card sets the foundation base rank.

0.title: Setup
0.body: 7 Klondike columns. First stock card flipped sets the base rank of all 4 foundations.

1.title: Tableau
1.body: Descending SAME-SUIT (not alternating like classic Klondike).

2.title: Foundations
2.body: Start at the revealed rank and wrap (e.g. 7 → 6 → 5 → … → 8).

3.title: Stock
3.body: No stock to draw after initial deal — all or nothing.

4.title: Note
4.body: This session uses standard Klondike rules.

agnes_bernauer.name: Agnes Bernauer
agnes_bernauer.shortDesc: Agnes Sorel variant with a 7-card reserve.

0.title: Setup
0.body: 7 Klondike columns + 7 face-up reserve cards. First stock card sets foundation base.

1.title: Reserve
1.body: Play any reserve card directly to tableau or foundations at any time.

2.title: Tableau & foundations
2.body: Like Agnes Sorel: descending same-suit, base from revealed rank.

3.title: Note
3.body: This session uses the standard Klondike engine.

black_widow.name: Black Widow
black_widow.shortDesc: Spider 4 suits with alternating-color stacking instead of same suit.

0.title: Difference vs Spider 4 Suits
0.body: Tableau stacks by ALTERNATING colors (red on black) instead of same suit.

1.title: Run movement
1.body: A run is movable if it respects the color alternation — many more valid combos.

2.title: Setup
2.body: 2 full decks (104 cards), 10 columns, 50 cards in stock.

3.title: Note
3.body: This session uses standard Spider (same suit).

scorpion.name: Scorpion
scorpion.shortDesc: 1-deck Spider, 7 columns of 7 — free pile movement.

0.title: Setup
0.body: 7 columns of 7 cards (49 cards), mixed face up/down. 3 cards left in stock (1 deal).

1.title: Tableau
1.body: Descending SAME suit (♠ on ♠).

2.title: Unique flexibility
2.body: Move ANY card with everything ABOVE it — even if not a valid run.

3.title: Stock
3.body: Single 3-card deal.

4.title: Note
4.body: This session uses standard 2-deck Spider.

wasp.name: Wasp
wasp.shortDesc: Scorpion variant — any run accepts an empty column.

0.title: Setup
0.body: 7 columns of 7 cards, like Scorpion.

1.title: Difference vs Scorpion
1.body: Any sequence can occupy an empty column (not just a King).

2.title: Tableau
2.body: Same-suit descending, free movement.

simple_simon.name: Simple Simon
simple_simon.shortDesc: 1-deck Spider, all face-up, staggered deal — no stock.

0.title: Setup
0.body: 10 columns in deal 8-7-6-5-4-3-2-1-8-8 (52 total). All face-up.

1.title: No stock
1.body: All cards on tableau from start.

2.title: Tableau
2.body: Same-suit descending. Complete King → Ace run auto-removes.

3.title: Win
3.body: 4 complete runs formed.

4.title: Note
4.body: This session uses standard 2-deck Spider.

relaxed_spider.name: Relaxed Spider
relaxed_spider.shortDesc: Spider 4 suits with relaxed rules — stock deals allowed with empty columns.

0.title: Difference
0.body: You can deal from stock even if there's an empty column. Game-changer.

1.title: Setup
1.body: Identical to Spider 4 suits (2 decks, 10 columns).

2.title: Tableau
2.body: Same-suit descending.

3.title: Note
3.body: This session uses strict Spider rules.

forecell.name: ForeCell
forecell.shortDesc: Strict FreeCell variant — the 4 Kings start in the free cells.

0.title: Setup
0.body: 8 columns of 6 cards (48 cards), the 4 Kings pre-placed in the 4 free cells.

1.title: Free cells
1.body: 4 cells start OCCUPIED by Kings — you must release them by placing on tableau.

2.title: Tableau
2.body: Descending alternating colors, like FreeCell.

3.title: Note
3.body: This session uses standard FreeCell (empty cells).

relaxed_freecell.name: FreeCell Relaxed
relaxed_freecell.shortDesc: FreeCell with smart auto-move and easier multi-card moves.

0.title: Setup
0.body: Identical to classic FreeCell: 8 columns, 4 free cells, 4 foundations.

1.title: Relaxation
1.body: Multi-card moves are auto-allowed if you have room; no manual calculation needed.

2.title: Auto-foundations
2.body: Cards that can safely go to foundations are auto-moved.

3.title: Note
3.body: This session uses standard FreeCell.

challenge_freecell.name: Challenge FreeCell
challenge_freecell.shortDesc: FreeCell with a biased shuffle for harder deals.

0.title: Setup
0.body: 8 columns, 4 cells, 4 foundations — like classic FreeCell.

1.title: Difference
1.body: Deal algorithm biases toward hard configurations: Aces and 2s deep, Kings on top.

2.title: Strategy
2.body: Identify problem columns early. Anticipate need for Kings in reserve.

3.title: Note
3.body: This session uses standard FreeCell shuffle.

australian_patience.name: Australian Patience
australian_patience.shortDesc: Yukon with same-suit stacking and a small stock to draw from.

0.title: Setup
0.body: 7 columns of 4 cards (28 cards), 24 cards in stock.

1.title: Tableau
1.body: Descending SAME suit (♠ on ♠).

2.title: Yukon flexibility
2.body: Move any card with what's below it.

3.title: Stock
3.body: 1 card at a time, no recycle.

4.title: Note
4.body: This session uses standard Yukon (alternating colors, no stock).

moosehide.name: Moosehide
moosehide.shortDesc: Yukon where stacking requires DIFFERENT suits (not just alternating colors).

0.title: Difference vs Yukon
0.body: Tableau stacks on ANY suit DIFFERENT from itself (more than alternating colors).

1.title: Yukon flexibility
1.body: Free bulk movement kept.

2.title: Note
2.body: This session uses standard Yukon (strict alternating colors).

black_hole.name: Black Hole
black_hole.shortDesc: Radial Golf — 17 piles of 3 around a central Ace ('the black hole').

0.title: Setup
0.body: 17 mini-piles of 3 face-up cards around the Ace of Spades center (the 'black hole').

1.title: Rule
1.body: Move a top-of-pile card to the black hole if value is ±1 vs the current center card. Suit irrelevant.

2.title: Circular
2.body: Ace ↔ King — the sequence is circular.

3.title: No stock
3.body: All 52 cards visible from start.

4.title: Win
4.body: All 51 outer cards absorbed by the black hole.

5.title: Note
5.body: This session uses standard Golf (7 columns).

giza.name: Giza
giza.shortDesc: Pyramid with 3 reserves of 8 cards — much more playable.

0.title: Setup
0.body: Standard 28-card pyramid + 3 reserves of 8 face-up cards (24 total).

1.title: Reserves
1.body: Pair the bottom card of each reserve with anything from pyramid or another reserve.

2.title: No stock
2.body: Everything is visible — no stock pile.

3.title: Pairs
3.body: Sum = 13, King alone. Like classic Pyramid.

4.title: Note
4.body: This session uses classic Pyramid (no reserves).

two_pyramids.name: Two Pyramids
two_pyramids.shortDesc: Two pyramids to empty in parallel — 56 cards instead of 28.

0.title: Setup
0.body: 2 side-by-side pyramids (28 + 28 = 56 cards from 2 decks).

1.title: Pairs
1.body: Sum = 13 between pyramids or with waste.

2.title: Stock
2.body: Like classic Pyramid.

3.title: Note
3.body: This session plays a single pyramid.

pharaoh.name: Pharaoh
pharaoh.shortDesc: Extended pyramid with Ace → King foundations alongside pair removal.

0.title: Dual goal
0.body: Empty the pyramid by pairs (sum=13) OR fill 4 foundations Ace → King by suit.

1.title: Pyramid
1.body: 7 rows face-up, like classic Pyramid.

2.title: Foundations
2.body: Ace → King by suit. Place a card from pyramid or waste.

3.title: Note
3.body: This session uses classic Pyramid without foundations.

0.title: Goal
0.body: Clear the 3 peaks (28 cards).

1.title: Setup
1.body: 3 peaks sharing a base row. Bottom row face-up; others hidden.

2.title: Rule
2.body: Remove a face-up card if value is ±1 vs waste card.

3.title: Circular
3.body: Ace ↔ King.

4.title: Combos
4.body: Chained cards without drawing double the score.

all_in_a_row.name: All in a Row
all_in_a_row.shortDesc: Linear TriPeaks — 52 cards in 4 rows, ±1 circular.

0.title: Setup
0.body: 52 cards in 4 rows of 13, all face-up.

1.title: Rule
1.body: Remove an 'exposed' card (at row ends or uncovered) if value is ±1 vs waste.

2.title: Circular
2.body: Ace ↔ King.

3.title: No stock
3.body: All cards visible — no stock pile.

4.title: Win
4.body: All 52 cards removed.

5.title: Note
5.body: This session uses standard TriPeaks (3 peaks).

limited.name: Limited
limited.shortDesc: Shorter Forty Thieves — 12 columns of 3 (instead of 10×4).

0.title: Setup
0.body: 2 decks (104 cards). 12 columns of 3 cards (36 on tableau). 68 cards in stock. 8 empty foundations.

1.title: Tableau
1.body: Descending same suit, 1 card at a time.

2.title: More accessible
2.body: Fewer cards on tableau initially — more stock margin.

3.title: Note
3.body: This session uses standard Forty Thieves (10×4).

lucas.name: Lucas
lucas.shortDesc: Forty Thieves with 13×3 columns — the 8 Aces pre-placed.

0.title: Setup
0.body: The 8 Aces are removed and placed as foundation bases. 13 columns of 3 cards (39 on tableau). 57 cards in stock.

1.title: Tableau
1.body: Descending same suit, 1 card at a time.

2.title: Advantage
2.body: Aces already placed — you only need to go from 2 to King by suit.

3.title: Note
3.body: This session uses standard Forty Thieves.

napoleon_st_helena.name: Napoleon at St. Helena
napoleon_st_helena.shortDesc: Forty Thieves with 4×10 layout and double Ace/King foundations.

0.title: Setup
0.body: 2 decks, 10 columns of 4 cards. 8 foundations: 4 ascending Ace → King and 4 descending King → Ace.

1.title: Tableau
1.body: Same-suit descending, 1 card at a time.

2.title: Challenge
2.body: Dual foundations force planning where each card will go.

3.title: Note
3.body: This session uses standard Forty Thieves (ascending only).

methuselah.name: Methuselah
methuselah.shortDesc: Accordion with relaxed rules — jumps ±1, ±3, AND ±5 left.

0.title: Setup
0.body: 52 cards in a line, face-up — like classic Accordion.

1.title: Difference
1.body: Move a card onto its neighbor 1, 3, OR 5 spots to the left (instead of just 1 or 3).

2.title: Stacking
